boundary: The helper, queue gate, status records, constants and all table producers are closed. The lethal ordering is bound to the full post-handler gate hash and its exact branch/call opcodes; no HP/active-unit load or branch exists between the effective-hit load at 0x0807764E and helper call at 0x0807766C. Per-status labels and dedicated animation timing remain presentation-layer work.
conclusion: After an effective opponent-target event, packed effect bit 0x80 creates one-turn status 0x3F and sets reaction state 0x30; bit 0x40 creates three-turn 10-percent attack, defense and agility reductions 0x1F/0x21/0x23. The post-handler gate checks only effective-hit and target-policy state before calling the follow-up helper, so a lethal effect also receives follow-ups.
